desc: The CobraTec Patent Pending Kuzio has been engineered and designed to offer a lifetime of use. The Kuzio is a solid performer that has been tested vigorously in the field. Each part has been CNC machined to offer a precise fit. Comes standard with a textured G-10 handle, glass breaker, right hand pocket clip, liner lock, lightly stonewashed D2 blade, finger stud and ball bearings to offer a very smooth and fast deployment. The Kuzio will soon become your go to EDC knife.
